turns.doctor_question: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, it's really nice to meet you too. Thank you for seeing me. Um... well, I guess I've just been feeling a little overwhelmed lately, if that's okay to say.

It’s probably silly to get so worked up over it, but every time I make even a small mistake at work—I wait tables, so it happens—it just feels like proof that I’m kind of useless. It just makes me feel like I deserve whatever bad things happen to me.
